rules.title: The Bomb
rules.tagline: The "pass the phone before it explodes" trend. The fuse is hidden. Good luck.
rules.warning: ⚠︎ The ticking speeds up but never tells you when it blows. No stalling, no cheating: pass.

steps.title: A category + the phone starts moving
steps.desc: E.g. "Soda brands". Sit in a circle.

steps.title: Name one, pass it fast
steps.desc: Say a word from the category, then hand the phone to your neighbor.

steps.title: 💥 punishes whoever's holding it
steps.desc: When the fuse runs out, you're stuck: you drink. Most explosions gets crowned.

live.passHintFirst: Say a word… then pass it fast!

blame.title:
Who was
holding it?
blame.subtitle: Point out the unlucky one. A sip is on the line.

exploded.title: {{name}} blew up
exploded.subtitle: The phone went off in your hands. Own it.
exploded.drink: Drink {{count}} sip{{plural}} and hand out {{count}} to whoever you want 🍻

podium.title: {{name}} blew it up every time
podium.subtitle: {{count}} explosion{{plural}} in their hands. The bar awaits.
podium.subtitleNone: Ninja reflexes, all of you. Suspicious.
